answer: Use beacon-anchored stake renewal: each epoch the network publishes a beacon, and every identity must renew by locking a small jade deposit and posting a beacon-tied record of real work done since the last beacon. Standing is tiered like a mesa: identities that keep renewing climb to higher tiers with more weight, while one that misses a beacon slides down and forfeits its deposit. An attacker minting thousands of fakes must fund a deposit for each one and produce fresh work for every identity at every beacon, so cost scales with fake count, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its tier.
